# add scripts to manage go-tool fork

Keep the author's fork of `golang.org/x/tools` — [kamilsk/go-tools](https://github.com/kamilsk/go-tools), branch `extended`, which carries a patched `goimports` — maintainable from the dotfiles instead of from the Taskfile inside the fork. The tasks are the usual fork chores: sync with upstream, rebase the patches, cut a tag, publish the Homebrew formula.
